Enabled.Name: Show screen effects
Enabled.Hint: Show a full-screen effect while your character suffers a condition. Turns them off on this computer only.

Intensity.Name: Effect strength
Intensity.Hint: How strong the screen effects are on this computer.

Calm.Name: Reduce motion
Calm.Hint: No pulsing, swaying or blinking: the effects stay still. Also follows your system's reduced-motion setting.

LowHp.Name: Low HP threshold (%)
LowHp.Hint: The Low HP effect starts when a character has this share of their hit points or less, and grows stronger as HP drops.

Gm.Name: Show effects to the GM
Gm.Hint: Also show the effects on the GM's screen for the token the GM has selected.

Menu.Name: Screen effects
Menu.Label: Choose effects
Menu.Hint: Turn single effects on or off on this computer, and preview them.
Menu.Intro: Choose which conditions show an effect on your screen. Preview shows an effect for a few seconds.
